question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "shake."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"shake"** in the blank is that a **"shake" **of the head is a physical gesture commonly associated with indicating a negative reaction. (रिक्त स्थान में **"shake"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह है कि सिर का "हिलाना" एक शारीरिक इशारा है जो आमतौर पर नकारात्मक प्रतिक्रिया को इंगित करने से जुड़ा होता है।)
 
• When someone shakes their head, they usually move it from side to side, and this action is widely interpreted as a gesture of disagreement or disapproval.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Body language transmits__ ideas or thoughts by certain actions, either intentionally or unintentionally. A __wink__ can be a way of flirting or indicating that the party is only joking. A __nod__ signifies approval, while __**shake**__ of the head indicates a negative reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Wink: an act of winking. (आँख मिचमिचाना)
 
• Clap: an act of clapping. (ताली बजाने की क्रिया; ताली)
 
• Nod: an act of nodding the head. (नवाई, नगन)
